nameOrigin: lizard-like amphibian (also a mythical fire-dwelling creature)

pokedexEntries.su: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

pokedexEntries.mo: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

pokedexEntries.us: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

pokedexEntries.um: It punishes Salandit that couldn’t bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.

pokedexEntries.sw: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

pokedexEntries.sh: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

pokedexEntries.sc: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

pokedexEntries.vi: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other's group.
